notes: Official-API translation of the native-green 34-assertion HLA_EVOKED class Request Attribute Value Update equivalence case. The adapter supplies a dimensional IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM, object/attribute/dimension names, provider, and endpoint. An ordinary class request and a broad explicit-region class request must each solicit both a region-associated object and a default-region object with their own exact tags and attribute set. Native focused CTest passed 1/1; installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 2/2 direct runs and 2/2 focused CTests (out/mgw/default-region-class-request-equivalence-20261021.json). Java compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider runtime. This checks only the bounded default-region equivalence mapped to section 9.1.8; it does not claim all DDM semantics, immediate callbacks, multi-provider interoperability, or general conformance.
